name: SolMar Sunglasses
description: Sunglasses designed for the outdoor lifestyle.
story: SolMar Sunglasses is a Portuguese brand dedicated to providing high-quality eyewear for an active lifestyle. We believe in pushing boundaries and celebrating human achievement, which aligns perfectly with the spirit of motorsport. We seek a partnership that showcases our brand to a global audience and highlights the performance and reliability of our products under pressure.
